scope: Two recommended additional cases followed by two strong alternatives from the same24-candidate native GPU1 batch. Qualitative selection, not a measured success rate.

examples.label: RECOMMENDED: board appearance
examples.note: Yellow donor-like color/markings transfer. Broad snow/person preservation; exact board identity not claimed.

examples.label: RECOMMENDED: white bus exterior
examples.note: White/black exterior replaces green, with red neighbor broadly kept; target double-decker shape persists.

examples.label: ALTERNATIVE: shaggy coat and clothing
examples.note: Long/shaggy hair and donor-like cloth transfer; bowl broadly stays. Anatomy and exact identity are not verified.

examples.label: ALTERNATIVE: reverse suitcase transfer
examples.note: Patterned surface becomes silver with donor-like seams; child/room broadly remain, but size/handle changes.
